summary.text: Max Abramson is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
Abramson previously served in the House from Rockingham County districts and ran for governor in 2016 and for Congress in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Max Abramson was born in Kent, Washington, and earned an associate degree from Great Bay Community College in 2016.
Ballotpedia lists Abramson's profession as technology professional and says his career experience includes road construction and work as a merchant mariner.
Abramson has been affiliated with the Republican Liberty Caucus and the New Hampshire Liberty Alliance.
Abramson represented Rockingham 20 in the New Hampshire House from 2014 to 2016 and, after being elected to that district again in 2018, served until 2020 before being elected in Rockingham 37.
Abramson was assigned to the Municipal and County Government Committee in 2019-2020 and the Commerce and Consumer Affairs Committee in 2021-2022, and left office in December 2022.
Abramson lost the September 13, 2022 Republican primary for Rockingham 40 to Jason Janvrin.
Abramson was the Libertarian candidate for governor in 2016, and in 2024 finished sixth with 3.3 percent in the Republican primary for New Hampshire's 1st Congressional District.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Abramson described himself as a three-term state legislator and former member of the Winnacunnet and Seabrook budget committees and the Seabrook Planning Board.
Abramson listed term limits, ending the War on Drugs and securing the borders as areas of policy he is passionate about.
